MIN(tx_day) AS first_seen, MAX(tx_day) AS last_seen, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE (tx_day >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE) AND tx_day < CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE))) AS prev_tx, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE (tx_day >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND tx_day < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE))) AS cur_tx FROM valid GROUP BY client_key), classified AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_tx > 0 AND cur_tx > 0 THEN 'returning' WHEN previous_active, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE cur_tx > 0) AS current_active, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE category = 'new') AS "new", COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE category = 'returning') AS "returning", COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE category = 'reactivated') AS reactivated, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE category = 'between_period') AS between_period, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE category = 'not_returned') AS not_returned, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE cur_tx > 0 AND first_seen < CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)) AS existing_active, COALESCE(SUM(prev_tx), 0) AS transactions_previous, COALESCE(SUM(cur_tx), 0) AS transactions_current, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE prev_tx >= 2) AS clients_with_repeat_previous, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE cur_tx >= 2) AS clients_with_repeat_current, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM raw WHERE client_key IS NULL AND ((tx_day >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE) AND tx_day < CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)) OR (tx_day >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND tx_day < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)))) AS excluded_missing_id_rows, (SELECT COUNT(*) CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)) OR (tx_day >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND tx_day < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)))) AS raw_rows_in_periods, (SELECT MIN(tx_day) FROM raw) AS data_start, (SELECT MAX(tx_day) FROM raw) AS data_end FROM classified
